summary: On May 12, 2026, Leatt Corp's Board authorized a stock repurchase program for up to $419,410 of common stock through open market purchases under Rule 10b-18 and potential Rule 10b5-1 trading plans, expiring December 31, 2026. The company will repurchase shares at its discretion depending on market conditions, price, and alternative uses of capital. Repurchases may be conducted through a third-party broker under a 10b5-1 plan to avoid blackout periods. The program can be suspended at any time. Watch for periodic disclosure of repurchase volume and price; no risk-arb angle.
